# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Checklist: Java Stream Gatherers Showcase

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, educational quality, and architectural consistency of the Gatherers Showcase requirements before proceeding to implementation
**Created**: 2026-08-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///Users/lazolazarev/projects/java_gatherers/specs/001-gatherers-showcase/spec.md) | [plan.md](file:///Users/lazolazarev/projects/java_gatherers/specs/001-gatherers-showcase/plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness (Category 1 — Stateful Capabilities)

- [x] CHK001 Are sliding window requirements explicitly specified for moving average, rolling extrema, and peak detection? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.1]
- [x] CHK002 Are fixed batching requirements clear regarding the handling of remainder elements in non-divisible stream sizes? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.2]
- [x] CHK003 Are cumulative computations defined for running totals, running maximums, and prefix sums with initial states? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.3]
- [x] CHK004 Are concurrency limit and encounter-order preservation requirements explicitly defined for `mapConcurrent`? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.4]
- [x] CHK005 Are stream zipping requirements specified for streams of unequal length and termination conditions? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.5]
- [x] CHK006 Are deduplication and adjacency grouping requirements clearly distinguished from full-stream `distinct()` and `Collectors.groupingBy()`? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1.6]
- [x] CHK007 Are lookahead/lookbehind requirements defined with exact neighbor window access constraints? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.7]
- [x] CHK008 Are short-circuiting exit conditions defined for multi-failure thresholds and rolling limit triggers? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.8]
- [x] CHK009 Are token sequence transition states and emitted `TokenEvent` shapes completely specified for the stream state machine? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.9, Data-Model §1.3]
- [x] CHK010 Are bounded-memory constraints and priority ordering rules specified for reservoir sampling and top-K extraction? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.10]
- [x] CHK011 Are position-based and condition-based synthetic separator injection rules fully defined? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1.11]

## 2. Requirement Completeness (Category 2 — Stream Contrast & Reimplementation)

- [x] CHK012 Are behavioral equivalence acceptance criteria defined between standard `filter` and stateless custom gatherer? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2.1]
- [x] CHK013 Are transformation equivalence acceptance criteria defined between standard `map` and custom gatherer? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2.2]
- [x] CHK014 Are short-circuit termination mechanics consistently specified between `limit`/`takeWhile` and custom gatherers? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2.3]
- [x] CHK015 Are 0..n element downstream push requirements specified for custom `flatMap` reimplementation? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2.4]
- [x] CHK016 Are stateful Set memory retention rules and encounter ordering specified for custom `distinct`? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2.5]
- [x] CHK017 Is the intermediate single-element downstream emission contract of `Gatherers.fold` clearly contrasted with terminal `reduce`? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2.6]

## 3. Negative-Space & Boundary Requirements (Category 3 — Overkill & Anti-Patterns)

- [x] CHK018 Are negative-space criteria specified to demonstrate when stateless `map`/`filter` built-ins should be preferred over Gatherers? [Boundary, Spec §User Story 3.1]
- [x] CHK019 Are terminal collector boundaries explicitly contrasted with intermediate Gatherer responsibilities? [Boundary, Spec §User Story 3.2]
- [x] CHK020 Are full-dataset buffering limitations documented for global sorting in contrast to single-pass stream processing? [Boundary, Spec §User Story 3.3]
- [x] CHK021 Are CPU-bound parallel stream boundaries clearly distinguished from Virtual Thread I/O concurrency in `mapConcurrent`? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3.4]
- [x] CHK022 Are multi-pass dataset algorithm boundaries and memory tradeoffs explicitly specified? [Boundary, Spec §User Story 3.5]
- [x] CHK023 Are standard pagination (`skip`/`limit`) and unordered grouping (`Collectors.groupingBy`) boundaries documented as preferred idioms? [Boundary, Spec §User Story 3.6]
